extracted.name: Pork Tenderloin in Bourbon
extracted.description: Tender pork marinated in soy sauce, bourbon and more. May also be grilled.
instruction_lines: Mix together soy sauce, bourbon, brown sugar, and garlic. Pour over pork, cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours, turning occasionally.
Preheat oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Remove pork from marinade, and place on rack of shallow roasting pan.
Bake for 45 minutes or until a meat thermometer registers 145 degrees F (63 degrees C).
